# diversity-map

Read only the links the task needs.

## Direction and state

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Work rules and where to start.
- [second-iteration/plan.md](second-iteration/plan.md): Phases, packages, and the proof for each package.
- [second-iteration/status.md](second-iteration/status.md): Current state, running jobs, next steps, blockers.
- [second-iteration/metrics.md](second-iteration/metrics.md): Weekly numbers and reading rules.
- [second-iteration/decisions/index.md](second-iteration/decisions/index.md): One decision file per site section and per process.
- [second-iteration/outreach/index.md](second-iteration/outreach/index.md): Outreach drafts (findings, Show HN, Reddit, data desks) and the send log.

- [data/research/wave-1-finish-2026-10-20/README.md](data/research/wave-1-finish-2026-10-20/README.md): Local operation record for the 200-city server batch, exact city list, and live status paths.

- [data/research/europe-expansion-2026-10-20/README.md](data/research/europe-expansion-2026-10-20/README.md): New Europe candidates, boundary checks, server batches, and held-city records.

- [README.md](README.md): Project purpose and local setup.
